description: This file defines the class `Image_Graph_Figure_Ellipse`, which is responsible for representing and rendering an ellipse shape in the Image_Graph package. It extends a base element class and includes methods for constructing the ellipse and outputting it on a canvas.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Figure_Ellipse
classes.description: Class representing an ellipse shape that can be drawn on a canvas, extending the base element class in the Image_Graph package.

methods.name: Image_Graph_Figure_Ellipse
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ellipse with center coordinates and radii, and sets the bounding box.

methods.name: _done
methods.description: Outputs the ellipse shape to the canvas if superclasses methods succeed, by calling the canvas's ellipse drawing function.
